# Text to Handwriting

> Text to Handwriting is an advanced, privacy-first client-side web application that transforms digital text into authentic human handwriting across all global languages (Arabic, English, Hindi, Cyrillic, Chinese, and more).

## Overview
Text to Handwriting bridges the gap between digital typing efficiency and handwritten authenticity. Unlike basic font generators that render robotic, mathematically identical characters, this tool uses HTML5 Canvas and micro-jitter algorithms to simulate the physical imperfections of human writing (baseline drift, slight angular tilt, and ink bleed).

## Core Capabilities
- **Universal Multilingual Support**: 
  - Full Right-to-Left (RTL) support for Arabic, Persian, Urdu, and Hebrew with automatic right-margin orientation.
  - Ligature-safe rendering: Preserves cursive character connections in Arabic and Indic scripts without tearing letters apart.
  - Dedicated fonts for Latin, Cyrillic (Russian), Devanagari (Hindi), and CJK (Chinese).
- **Customizable Paper & Ink Styles**:
  - Paper templates: Lined notebook, clean plain white, math grid, vintage parchment, and yellow legal pad.
  - Realistic pen ink colors: Royal navy blue, black gel, ballpoint blue, grading red, and custom hex color picker.
- **Natural Imperfection Engine**:
  - Baseline jitter control (0 to 5px).
  - Dynamic line height and font size adjustment.
- **Export Options**:
  - High-DPI print-ready PNG download.
  - Direct browser Print to PDF formatting.
- **Zero-Data Storage (Privacy First)**:
  - 100% in-browser client-side execution.
  - No text or exported files are ever sent to, processed by, or stored on remote servers.

## Site Structure & Documentation
- [Text to Handwriting Tool](https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/Texttohandwriting/): The interactive web application and converter.
- [About Us](https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/Texttohandwriting/about.html): Background on the algorithmic approach, typographic ligatures, and mission.
- [Privacy Policy](https://ahmedelazabdev.github.io/Texttohandwriting/privacy.html): Comprehensive disclosure of client-side execution and zero data retention.

## Technical Stack
- Vanilla JavaScript & HTML5 Canvas API (High-DPI 2x Retina rendering).
- CSS3 with zero heavy external UI frameworks for sub-second Core Web Vitals.
- Dynamic On-Demand Font Loader via Google Fonts API.
